name: glfx.js effects
description: Colour adjustments, blurs, warps and stylised looks from Evan Wallace's glfx.js.
author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Brightness / contrast
addons.description: Lift or drop the brightness and stretch or flatten the contrast.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Hue / saturation
addons.description: Rotate the hues and boost or wash out the colour.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Vibrance
addons.description: Boosts the dull colours more than the already-saturated ones.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Sepia

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Tilt-shift
addons.description: Blurs the top and bottom of the frame so the ride looks like a miniature model.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Zoom blur
addons.description: Streaks everything toward a point, like a hard launch.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Ink
addons.description: Darkens the edges like an ink drawing.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Hexagon pixelate
addons.description: Turns the picture into a honeycomb of flat hexagons.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Colour halftone
addons.description: CMYK print dots, like a comic or a magazine.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Dot screen

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Swirl
addons.description: Twists the middle of the frame around its centre.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Bulge / pinch
addons.description: A fisheye bulge (or pinch) in the middle of the frame.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Vignette
addons.description: Darkens the corners to pull the eye to the rider.

addons.author: Evan Wallace (glfx.js)
addons.name: Film grain
addons.description: Moving grain over the whole frame.
